title: hypericum laeve var. rubrum
intro: Hypericum laeve var. rubrum, commonly known as Red St. John's Wort, is a shrubby, perennial plant species within the Hypericum genus, known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, depression, and insomnia, due to its health benefits, which include stress relief, immune system support, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Red St. John's Wort are attributed to its ability to inhibit the reuptake of neurotransmitters like serotonin, thereby exerting anxiolytic and antidepressant effects. The bioactive constituents of Red St. John's Wort include hypericin, hyperforin, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
